name: Tidewater Greens
tagline: Cool-coast lettuces, chard and cutting herbs, crisp the year round.
imageAlt: Rows of leafy kale in a garden
stand: CSA pickup Tue & Fri; market Sat
description: In Half Moon Bay, CA, Tidewater Greens grows Kale, Lettuces, Chard, and Cooking herbs on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. It follows certified organic, low-till beds, and coastal fog-irrigated practices. It has been growing since 2012. The season runs through spring, summer, and much of the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
